comparison.objective: Transfer support of a gravity-loaded cover and control its closure; candidate tunes a damper through iterative impacts.
comparison.physical_skill: Support handoff and continuous gravity-load control versus key insertion, retained-collar adjustment, counterholding, and bounded fastener torque.
comparison.success_condition: Observable closing speed is constrained, but its numeric limit and final pose tolerance are absent; candidate requires two cycles meeting explicit stroke, impact, rebound, overload, and drift gates.
comparison.reason: Controlled closure tests load transfer and motion regulation, not parameter adjustment and post-lock validation.
